messages:
Priya (Finance): @channel New billing policy: we9re introducing an Adaptive Overage Grace (AOG) and an automatic Quota Top-up mechanism to reduce invoice surprises from short-lived traffic spikes. Effective date: 2026-12-01 UTC.

Priya (Finance): TL;DR: small, abrupt spikes will be covered by AOG credits (no immediate invoice overage). Accounts may receive up to a transient top-up equal to 20% of their monthly allotment automatically, capped at 3 triggers per rolling year. Any usage > top-up is billed normally.

Marco (Billing): Mechanics: AOG is an invoice credit, not cash. Trigger conditions: 1) minute-level usage > 5x median 7-day usage AND 2) spike duration <= 72 hours. Top-up amount = min(20% of monthly_alloc, 50,000 tokens/minutes equivalent). We'll emit `billing.event.aog_applied.v1` when credit is applied.

Sam (Eng): Spec for headers: responses include `X-AOG-Applied: true|false`, `X-AOG-Amount: <units>`, and `X-Migration-ID` after cutover. Also adding a /billing/aog-preview endpoint for internal preview.

Tess (Product): Customer comms: 1) console banner two weeks prior; 2) preview tool that shows AOG eligibility and projected invoice smoothing; 3) FAQ Q&A: how many times AOG can trigger, scope, and that top-ups are auto-applied. Draft console copy below.

Aisha (Support): Support playbook: - If customer asks why AOG applied/wasn't applied, run preview & include `aog_reason` from API. - If customer wants to opt out of AOG (some partners prefer raw metering), route to billing@ with `aog_optout` flag. - Disputes: open billing-escalations if post-AOG invoice delta >20%.

Darren (Legal): Legal constraints: AOG cannot be used to alter committed Dedicated reservations. Opt-outs require a signed amendment for enterprise customers. I'll add short footer language: "Adaptive Overage Grace may be applied to smooth transient usage; it does not change contractual reservations."

Marco (Billing): Data request: run a preview job by 2026-11-10 that flags accounts likely to trigger AOG in the first 90 days and include: account_id, monthly_alloc, preview_spike_count, aog_eligible (bool), migration_id. CSV to billing + support + product.

ops-billing-bot: preview_job queued -> scheduled 2026-11-01T04:00:00Z

Priya (Finance): Billing rules: AOG credit is applied automatically and reconciled on the following invoice as a separate line item `aog_credit`. If an account triggers >3 times in rolling 12 months, further top-ups are disabled until review.

Tess (Product): Console preview snippet:

```
Starting Dec 1, 2026 we will auto-apply an Adaptive Overage Grace (AOG) for short spikes. Preview whether your account is eligible and see the estimated top-up amount. Toggle opt-out in account settings if you prefer raw metering.
```

Aisha (Support): Quick Q: will the preview CSV include an `aog_optout_allowed` boolean so we can surface toggle?

Marco (Billing): Yes 95 CSV includes `aog_eligible`, `aog_optout_allowed`, `preview_spike_count`, and `migration_id`.

Darren (Legal): Rollback/opt-out note: customers may opt out at any time; opt-out starts next billing cycle. Rollbacks of applied AOG credits are only available if an error is detected in our trigger logic; that's handled as a billing dispute.

Priya (Finance): Safety valve: if more than 0.6% of active accounts dispute AOG in first 72 hours, we will pause auto-apply for 48 hours and run an RCA.

Sam (Eng): Engineering checklist: - /billing/aog-preview API - headers `X-AOG-*` on responses - emit `billing.event.aog_applied.v1` and `billing.event.aog_revoked.v1` - preview UI widget - add `aog_optout` flag on account object.

Marco (Billing): Sample support message: "Hi <customer>, we applied Adaptive Overage Grace to smooth a short usage spike on your account. The credit applied is shown on your next invoice as `aog_credit`. If you'd like to opt out of AOG, we can toggle that for you (or you can do it in settings). 94 Marco, Billing"

Tess (Product): Timeline: - 2026-11-01: preview job scheduled - 2026-11-10: preview CSV to teams - 2026-11-17: console preview widget + banner live - 2026-12-01: cutover (AOG auto-applies).

Aisha (Support): I'll schedule 60-min training on 2026-11-18 and prepare ticket templates and an `optout` flow doc.

Darren (Legal): Action: I'll post final legal footer by 2026-11-05 and prepare opt-out amendment for enterprise accounts.

Priya (Finance): Action items: Marco -> preview CSV 2026-11-10; Eng -> API + headers + events by 2026-11-17; Support -> training + opt-out form by 2026-11-18; Legal -> final copy by 2026-11-05.

ops-billing-bot: preview_job: completed (rows: 3150) -> storage:/migrations/2026-11-aog-preview-3187654321.csv

Priya (Finance): Thanks all. If anyone wants to run simulated cases against the preview dataset, DM me and I'll share temporary migration_id tokens.
